metadata.title: Comprehensive ECH MHD-Oscillation Analysis for Heliotron J (#88653 & #88654)

primary_acoustic_scaling_hypothesis.evidence: Primary mode drops only -3.7% vs predicted acoustic drop of -25.0%. Pearson r = 0.20 [95% CI: 0.11, 0.28] with N_eff = 56.4. Pure sound-speed scaling is ruled out.
primary_acoustic_scaling_hypothesis.physical_interpretation: Primary mode is governed by the Alfven velocity v_A = B / sqrt(mu0 * rho) rather than sound speed c_s. Characteristic of fast-ion TAE/GAE branch.
artifacts_considered: ECE uncalibrated baseline offset mitigated via robust floor correction
Bartlett bivariate autocorrelation correction applied

secondary_acoustic_coupling_hypothesis.physical_interpretation: Secondary mode exhibits partial frequency tracking with electron cooling, consistent with mixed acoustic-Alfven coupling (BAE branch) or plasma rotation deceleration.

claim_1_macro_drift_reversal.summary: Macroscopic frequency drift of Primary mode inverts from positive (+0.22 to +0.49 kHz/ms) during ECH+NBI to negative (-0.80 to -0.95 kHz/ms) during NBI-only across ECH shut-off (t = 291.2 ms) in both shots.

claim_2_downward_chirping_dominance.summary: Individual discrete burst events within the primary mode are 100% downward chirping (df/dt < 0) across both heating phases in both discharges.

claim_3_transient_amplitude_surge.summary: In replicate #88654, Primary envelope RMS surges by 3.48x [95% CI: 1.20x, 5.68x] within 2 ms of ECH-off, confirmed as a coherent physical rotating MHD mode via toroidal array cross-correlation (R=0.98-0.995, tau=3-6 us delay). In #88653, fluctuation envelope increases by 1.22x [95% CI: 0.98x, 1.70x].

claim_4_thermal_power_discontinuity.summary: Diamagnetic energy time derivative dWp/dt exhibits an immediate negative step jump across 291.2 ms of -60.9 kJ/s (#88653) and -68.3 kJ/s (#88654), confirming prompt loss of ~61-68 kW thermal heating.

claim_5_primary_acoustic_scaling.summary: Primary mode frequency drops by only ~7% while electron temperature proxy collapses by >80% (predicted acoustic drop ~58%). Pearson r is weak (0.20-0.29). Ruled out pure acoustic/GAM/BAE scaling; confirms fast-ion Alfvenic branch.

claim_6_secondary_acoustic_coupling.summary: Secondary mode frequency drops by ~26%, showing moderate correlation (r = 0.42-0.50) with electron cooling proxy. Indicates mixed acoustic-Alfven coupling or rotation deceleration.
